This is LeetCode 2918, "Minimum Equal Sum of Two Arrays with Zeros." The expected outputs follow from the standard rule. Let s1 = sum(nums1) + (number of zeros in nums1) and s2 = sum(nums2) + (number of zeros in nums2), the smallest sums each array can reach.

- If both arrays contain zeros, the answer is max(s1, s2).
- If only nums1 contains zeros, the answer is s2 when s2 ≥ s1, otherwise -1. The symmetric case applies when only nums2 has zeros.
- If neither contains zeros, the answer is s1 when s1 = s2, otherwise -1.

I worked each case out by hand from this rule.
